hero.title: Run your business on
hero.lead: I build simple custom software for small businesses of 1–50 people, made around how you already work. No big agency, no account managers. You work with me directly.
hero.cta: Let's See What We Can Improve
hero.free: The review, meeting, and quote are free. You only pay if you decide to go ahead.

problems.lead: A few examples of what I build. Your business is different, so your tool will be too.

items.problem: Only one person understands the schedule.
items.problem_text: It lives in a spreadsheet, and everyone else keeps asking.
items.title: Everyone sees the same schedule.
items.text: One shared calendar with automatic reminders, so fewer no-shows and fewer phone calls.

items.problem_text: Someone's out sick, and nobody knows what was promised.
items.title: Every job stays on track.
items.text: See each job, its status, and who's on it, so nothing depends on one person's memory.

items.problem_text: It's scattered across texts, emails, and notebooks.
items.title: Find any customer in seconds.
items.text: Contacts, notes, and history, all in one place.

items.problem_text: Invoices and reports get built by hand, every week.
items.title: Paperwork that does itself.
items.text: Invoices are made from finished jobs, and reports are ready when you need them.

items.problem_text: If they can't find you online or you miss the call, they move on.
items.title: Customers book any time.
items.text: A website that brings people in and lets them book or order day or night.

items.problem_text: Someone has to copy their details onto paper first.
items.title: Check-in takes seconds.
items.text: A tablet at the front desk handles check-in, sign-ups, or orders.

items.problem: You run out of stock by surprise.
items.problem_text: You find out when a customer asks for it.
items.title: Know what to reorder before you run out.
items.text: See stock levels at a glance, with no counting by hand.

items.problem: You type the same thing three times.
items.problem_text: Every order goes into three different places.
items.title: Enter it once, and you're done.
items.text: Your tools share data automatically, and routine work runs itself.

more.title: Something else?
more.text: These are only examples. Tell me what slows you down, and I'll tell you if a tool can fix it.

steps.title: Tell me about your business
steps.text: Fill out a short form. It takes about two minutes and helps me come prepared.

steps.title: Meet
steps.text: We meet in person in Jacksonville, or talk on the phone. You show me how things work today.

steps.title: Quote
steps.text: A fixed scope and price in writing. No obligation.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: 1–4 weeks. You try it along the way, so there are no surprises at the end.

steps.title: Support
steps.text: Hosting, backups, fixes, and small changes, with a real person who answers.

about: I'm Alex, a software developer in Jacksonville with 25+ years of building websites, web applications, and business systems.
